title: NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ: NVDA) — Institutional Investment Dossier
primer: NVIDIA posted $115.8B in Q3 FY27 revenue (+103% YoY) and 74.23% ROIC. However, co-founder Jensen Huang resigned Nov 11–12, leaving CFO Colette Kress as Interim CEO amid an active SEC inquiry. Long-term debt jumped 4.3x to $32.37B alongside $65.53B in illiquid securities and $668B in commitments and guarantees. Shares closed at $125.53 on Nov 20 (Stage 1 in facts, -39.4% vs 50D SMA) and bounced to $166.33 on Nov 23 (STAGE_4, CAP_REJECTED). We rate NVDA REJECTED (TIER_0), decline options (NO_OPTIONS_EDGE), and hold 100% of marginal US cash in T-Bills.
